results.name: Polynomial.monic_normalize
results.source_text:
theorem monic_normalize [DecidableEq R] (hp0 : p ≠ 0) : Monic (normalize p) := by
  rw [Ne, ← leadingCoeff_eq_zero, ← Ne, ← isUnit_iff_ne_zero] at hp0
  rw [Monic, leadingCoeff_normalize, normalize_eq_one]
  apply hp0

results.name: Polynomial.Monic.normalize_eq_self
results.source_text:
theorem Monic.normalize_eq_self {p : R[X]} (hp : p.Monic) : normalize p = p := by
  simp only [Polynomial.coe_normUnit, normalize_apply, hp.leadingCoeff, normUnit_one,
    Units.val_one, Polynomial.C.map_one, mul_one]

results.name: Polynomial.monic_mul_leadingCoeff_inv
results.source_text:
theorem monic_mul_leadingCoeff_inv {p : K[X]} (h : p ≠ 0) : Monic (p * C (leadingCoeff p)⁻¹) := by
  rw [Monic, leadingCoeff_mul, leadingCoeff_C,
    mul_inv_cancel₀ (show leadingCoeff p ≠ 0 from mt leadingCoeff_eq_zero.1 h)]

results.name: Polynomial.normalize_eq_self_iff_monic
results.source_text:
theorem normalize_eq_self_iff_monic [DecidableEq R] {p : R[X]} (hp : p ≠ 0) :
    normalize p = p ↔ p.Monic :=
  ⟨fun h ↦ h ▸ monic_normalize hp, fun h ↦ Monic.normalize_eq_self h⟩

results.name: Polynomial.Monic.eq_X_add_C
results.source_text:
theorem Monic.eq_X_add_C (hm : p.Monic) (hnd : p.natDegree = 1) : p = X + C (p.coeff 0) := by
  rw [← one_mul X, ← C_1, ← hm.coeff_natDegree, hnd, ← eq_X_add_C_of_natDegree_le_one hnd.le]

results.name: Polynomial.monic_X_pow_add
results.source_text:
theorem monic_X_pow_add {n : ℕ} (H : degree p < n) : Monic (X ^ n + p) :=
  monic_of_degree_le n
    (le_trans (degree_add_le _ _) (max_le (degree_X_pow_le _) (le_of_lt H)))
    (by rw [coeff_add, coeff_X_pow, if_pos rfl, coeff_eq_zero_of_degree_lt H, add_zero])

results.name: Polynomial.monic_X_add_C
results.source_text:
theorem monic_X_add_C (x : R) : Monic (X + C x) :=
  pow_one (X : R[X]) ▸ monic_X_pow_add_C x one_ne_zero

results.name: Polynomial.monic_X_sub_C
results.source_text:
theorem monic_X_sub_C (x : R) : Monic (X - C x) := by
  simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, C_neg] using monic_X_add_C (-x)

results.name: gcd_eq_normalize
results.source_text:
theorem gcd_eq_normalize [NormalizedGCDMonoid α] {a b c : α} (habc : gcd a b ∣ c)
    (hcab : c ∣ gcd a b) : gcd a b = normalize c :=
  normalize_gcd a b ▸ normalize_eq_normalize habc hcab

results.name: Multiset.normalize_gcd
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem normalize_gcd (s : Multiset α) : normalize s.gcd = s.gcd :=
  Multiset.induction_on s (by simp) fun a s _ ↦ by simp

results.name: Finset.normalize_gcd
results.source_text:
@[local simp] -- This will later be provable by other `simp` lemmas.
theorem normalize_gcd : normalize (s.gcd f) = s.gcd f := by simp [gcd_def]

results.name: gcd_eq_right_iff
results.source_text:
theorem gcd_eq_right_iff [NormalizedGCDMonoid α] (a b : α) (h : normalize b = b) :
    gcd a b = b ↔ b ∣ a := by simpa only [gcd_comm a b] using gcd_eq_left_iff b a h

results.name: normalize_gcd
results.source_text:
@[simp]
theorem normalize_gcd [NormalizedGCDMonoid α] : ∀ a b : α, normalize (gcd a b) = gcd a b :=
  NormalizedGCDMonoid.normalize_gcd
